phases.objective: Keep the repository regression contract aligned with the trusted default-branch generated-artifact command workflow, including canonical publication of fail-closed protected-target decisions without granting protected-branch dispatch or mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted repository operator and repository automation
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A newly created trusted pull-request comment or explicit workflow_dispatch command on the default-branch workflow definition, or a structured blocked decision produced while rejecting an invalid protected-target request
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher validates the exact PR head, delegates only eligible governed work branches to the registered writer, publishes structured blocked evidence for protected-target requests without dispatching them, and retains no branch-push or direct contents-write authority.
steps: Accept only issue_comment created events or explicit workflow_dispatch inputs.
Reject work-branch push and pull-request workflow entrypoints.
Require a trusted author association, same-repository PR, exact lowercase SHA, and explicit refresh label before any eligible writer delegation.
Reject main and Production before writer dispatch and record dispatch_requested=false in the structured blocked decision.
Checkout publisher code from main with persisted credentials disabled.
Permit the publisher to accept main or Production as target identity only for blocked evidence with dispatch_requested=false.
Reject passed or skipped protected-target evidence and reject any blocked protected-target evidence claiming dispatch_requested=true.
Dispatch the registered exact-head writer only for an eligible governed work branch with typed confirmation.
Publish the exact structured decision to the associated PR before enforcing the outcome.
assertions: The workflow has no push trigger.
The workflow has actions:write, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:read, with no contents:write.
Publisher code is loaded from main with persist-credentials=false.
The dispatcher performs no git push or direct repository contents mutation.
Protected branches remain ineligible for writer dispatch or repository mutation.
A protected target may appear in publisher input only when outcome=blocked and dispatch_requested=false so the fail-closed decision can be recorded.
Passed or skipped protected-target evidence is rejected.
Malformed candidates, untrusted authors, ambiguous PRs, and stale heads fail closed.
The structured report declares consult_job_logs=false and secrets_included=false.
The canonical decision is published directly before enforcement.

phases.objective: Prove one live trusted comment command publishes a canonical dispatcher decision and delegates the exact-head writer.
Exercise stale-head, missing-label, ambiguous-PR, dispatch rejection, protected-target blocked-evidence publication, and publisher failure paths without Job-log authority.
Observe one non-production generated-artifact refresh through the trusted command path.
The dispatcher rejects protected branches from writer execution and grants no deployment or Production mutation authority; protected-target identities are publishable only as blocked evidence.
